evidence: This slug was given 13.1s, 30.0s and 13.5s and sent no bytes in any of the three attempts, so it is the one the click is waiting on. The fix is to give it a longer timeout so it can finish.
why_it_was_missed: The 429s on the gemma slugs pushed the walk down to the last model in the list, so this is really a rate-limit problem that happens to land on the slowest slug.
does_not_fix: Nothing; raising BLOG_AI_TIMEOUT_MS to 60s gives the model room to answer.
